Hi team,

Quick mapping and notes below — attaching a CSV with the raw mapping.

Meter -> Redwood SKU (recommended):
- gcp.inference_seconds -> sku.inference.standard_hour (billed in 1-second granularity, rounded up to 1 minute for invoicing)
- gcp.embeddings_requests -> sku.embeddings.request (per-request meter, aggregated daily)
- gcp.context_tokens -> sku.input_tokens (used only for models billed by token)

Edge cases / crediting notes:
- Trial credits: treat as a pre-payment bucket. We recommend applying trial credits before calculating partner uplift (credits reduce billed amount that uplift is applied to). This is how the majority of marketplaces expect credits to appear, and it avoids negative uplifts.
- Free-tier usage: map into a zero-dollar line item; do not apply partner uplift to free-tier rows.
- Rounding: round usage up to nearest minute for inference_seconds; small-volume rounding errors should be reconciled monthly (see finance notes).

Attachment: metering_mapping.csv (text/csv)

If CloudScale prefers uplift applied as a separate billed line (instead of changing list price), that's technically straightforward — we add a \"Partner uplift\" line that references the original SKU lines. Operationally it makes reconciliation on their side easier.

Irene

Thanks Irene — good mapping. Finance notes / recommendation below.

Recommended uplift approach: 6% partner uplift applied as a separate invoice line (\"Partner uplift\") per month, calculated on the net-billed amount after credits but before marketplace pass-through fees. Rationale: keeps list prices stable, makes accounting transparent for resellers.

Reconciliation cadence: monthly invoice is issued on day 5 of the following month; we perform a gross->net reconciliation 30 days post-invoice to true-up rounding and any retro credits. Any adjustment > $500 will be issued as a credit on the subsequent invoice.

Waterfall example (sample_workback.xlsx attached):
1) Raw usage (aggregation per meter)
2) Apply rounding rules / free-tier exclusions
3) Subtract promotional/trial credits (pre-billing bucket)
4) Compute Partner uplift (6%) as separate line on invoice
5) Apply marketplace fees/pass-throughs (displayed separately)
6) Month+30 true-up (adjustment credit or invoice)

Tax / commission: uplift is subject to standard VAT handling where applicable; reseller commissions are calculated on the uplift-inclusive lines per our partner agreement.

Attachments: reconciliation_formula.md (text/markdown), sample_workback.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

If Ben or Rishi want a bridge number, we can propose 5-8% as marketable range; 6% is defensible for customers with predictable volume.

Vivek Kulkarni
